description: Search for files in Google Drive. Results are sorted most-recently-modified first by default; use orderBy for a different order. Set rawQuery=true to pass a raw Google Drive API query supporting operators like modifiedTime, createdTime, mimeType, name contains, etc.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

orderBy.description: Sort order for results. Keys without 'desc' sort ascending, so 'modifiedTime' is oldest-first. When paging, repeat the same value on every pageToken call.

pageToken.description: Token for next page of results

query.description: Search query. When rawQuery=true, this is passed directly to the Google Drive API as the q parameter.

rawQuery.description: If true, pass query directly to Google Drive API without wrapping in fullText contains. Enables date filters, mimeType filters, etc.

name: search
